title: The Sea Just Within Reach
html:
The Sea Just Within Reach

Quest Type

Side

Requirements

Complete Main Quest Ode to the Second Sunrise in Chapter III: Act II
Complete Submerged Tunnel (Quest)

Description

Discuss the Submerged Tunnel rebuild with Abby
  • Rewards
  • Characters
1
1
10,000
Mornye, Rover
The Sea Just Within Reach is a Side Quest that occurs in Bjartr Woods, Roya Frostlands, [[{{{nation}}}]].

Contents

  • 1 Steps
  • 2 Gameplay Notes
  • 3 Dialogue
  • 4 Other Languages
  • 5 Change History

Steps[]

  1. Check the Submerged Tunnel Memorial
  2. Check WavesLine
  3. Meet up with Mornye
  4. Ride the motorbike through the Submerged Tunnel
  5. Say goodbye to Mornye

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing this quest awards World in All Its Variety II trophy Do Submarines Dream of Data Sets?.

Dialogue[]

(Check the Submerged Tunnel Memorial)
Abby: The Submerged Tunnel is finally done! What an undertaking...
Abby: Let's see what it says: "Through its transparent design and holographic projections, the Submerged Tunnel offers travelers a breathtaking visual journey..."
Abby: And speaking of holograms... I have the coolest idea, Player!
Abby: Since the whole view is just a projection... whaddya say we project something even cooler?
Abby: Like, change the schools of fish into Dragons of Dirge, or turn the water into fire and make the whole tunnel a Path of the Inferno!
I like the way you think.
Abby: I know!
This isn't an amusement park.
Abby: Oh, just humor me would you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
Abby: Isn't Mornye some big scientist at the Research Institute? She can help us with this!
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Alright, alright...
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Mornye is still on sick leave. I'll send her a message.
(Check WavesLine)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
Mornye, Abby has a... strange question.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
Can the Submerged Tunnel project different types of holograms?
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
Like, say… a swarm of Dragons of Dirge? Or make the entire length of the tunnel a Path of the Inferno?
Mornye
(?)
Mornye
I wasn't part of the Submerged Tunnel project. To answer accurately would require a site survey and access to blueprints, construction logs, operational data…
Mornye
I recall that the tunnel runs from Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. I'm near Bjartr Woods now. I could come help you if you need it.
Aren't you on sick leave??
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
Aren't you on sick leave??
Mornye
...On an expedition. For a project.
Mornye
Don't worry. Dr. Herssen says my post-Overclocking symptoms are mostly recovered. Now, I just need to stay in a good mood.
Mornye
And… making research progress puts me in a very good mood.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
File:Sticker - Abby - Confused.png
What you need right now is rest.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
What you need right now is rest.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
Once your expedition is complete, meet me by the tunnel. We need to talk.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)
File:Sticker - Gulpuff - Fierce.png
Mornye
(Puppy dog eyes)
Mornye
...All right.
Not long after, you see Mornye walking toward you.
(Meet up with Mornye)
Mornye: Sorry to keep you waiting, Mentor.
Mornye: Before coming here, I did a remote search through the Institute's database.
Mornye: The projections can be changed, but to get the effects you're describing, you'd have to consider the optic engine architecture, lens quality, display chip specs…
Mornye: If you want, I could—
That's not what I wanted to talk about.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Don't you think you ought to be resting in your condition?
Mornye: But it's about keeping a good mood...
The Submerged Tunnel scenery is stunning.
How about we go take it in together?
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): You're going to love it, I'm sure of it.
Mornye: ...I see.
Mornye: Okay. I will endeavor to focus on enjoying this trip with you.
(Ride the motorbike through the Submerged Tunnel)
Mornye: I remember that before the Submerged Tunnel was closed, it was just an ordinary tunnel. I can't believe you managed to turn it into this.
Mornye: It's like going through the ocean in a submarine.
Wouldn't a fish make more sense?
Mornye: A fish's vision covers 360 degrees. I don't think a human could experience the scenery quite the way they do.
Mornye: Do you prefer to imagine yourself as a fish? Let me try. Maybe I can look in both directions at once...
A submarine? Cool!
Mornye: Exactly! They're used for deep-sea surveys. It uses multiple propellers, so it's highly maneuverable. It can move freely in the water...
Mornye: Heh... similar to how you're steering the motorbike right now.
Mornye: Wow, look, Mentor! Jellyfish!
Beautiful!
Mornye: They glow like stars in the ocean.
Too bad they're only holograms.
Mornye: Oh, I'm sorry. I should have said, "Look, holographically projected jellyfish!"
Mornye: I wonder if the real ones are even prettier.
Mornye: You know… even though I know so much about it, I've never actually seen the real ocean.
Mornye: Even though I was born in the New Federation, I never traveled because of my condition. And after coming to Lahai-Roi, I never left because of confidentiality requirements.
Mornye: I bet you've been to all sorts of places. Can you tell me what the ocean really looks like?
(Describe Rinascita's ocean)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): A blue sparkling with faith, myth, and celebration.
Mornye: It sounds... Beautiful. Serene.
(Describe the Black Shores)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): A black sea where fog and storms guard its secrets.
Mornye: Sounds like a place just begging to be explored.
Mornye: Even though this isn't the real ocean, it's still a sight to see.
Mornye: And the best kind of scenery is the kind I get to see with you.
(Say goodbye to Mornye)
Mornye: Thank you for showing me this, Mentor. I feel... really happy.
Mornye: It's like you said. Taking in the scenery really does help you keep a positive attitude.
Mornye: Oh, we're near the Research Institute now. I should get back to work.
Um...?
Mornye: Hehe... I'm only joking, Mentor.
Mornye: I'll rest up until my sick leave is over, just like you said.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): And after you go back to work.
Mornye: Of course.
Mornye: So, um... The next time I want to take a break, can I invite you? Like we did today?
Of course.
Mornye: Great.
Mornye: Then I'd like to reserve a spot in your schedule.
Mornye: I hope one day I'll get to see the real ocean with you.
(Quest Complete)
